caption: The drawing depicts a puppet or figurine with a detailed view from the front and a smaller profile view from the right side. The figure has a reddish-brown face with exaggerated facial features including large, round yellow and black eyes, a broad mouth with visible white teeth, and prominent lines and colors accentuating the cheeks and mouth. The hair is black and stylized, with a feathered ornament in shades of brown, white, and black attached at the top. The figure wears a brightly patterned upper garment with a green background and prominent pink floral motifs, as well as long red-brown glove-like hands. Around the waist, there is a beige rectangular apron or belt. From the waist extends a pair of yellow chaps or leggings with a vertical opening down the center, decorated with blue outlines and circular buttons, overlaid by a black fringed skirt. The figure's boots are black. The side view in the upper right corner displays the same features, highlighting the pronounced nose, lips, and feather at the back of the head. The background is a light beige or off-white, and the composition is centered with the two views separated but close together.
title: Hand Puppet
